note: G-ORB-498 red goldens: the transition is (let ((x 1)) (emit FOO { n: @x })). The effects list holds one bare let (status skipped though its emit ran), so a nested emit cannot be asserted through effects. red-* cases express what a closed gap must pass; controls pass today.

cases.note: Wants the emit FOO as an effect; today the only effect is the let, so this fails: that is the gap.
Asserts the let and nothing under it, so a nested emit of any name or payload would pass; the effect list carries no trace of FOO.

The only way to pin the nested emit through effects today: the let's raw source in arg1, compared whole. It asserts the written expression (status of the nested emit is lost: the let reports skipped although the emit ran), not the effects that ran.
